data.idea: An app to track how tall my plants grow

msg.text: Your builder is reading your idea and getting ready to write the plan.

data.text: Read your idea carefully

msg.text: Your builder is writing the plan: what you can do, which screens you see and what it remembers.

data.text: Wrote down the full plan for your app

data.question: Here is the plan for "Sprout Tracker". Shall I start building?
data.summary: A simple page where you keep a list of your plants and write down how tall they are, so you can watch them grow.

sections.title: What you will be able to do
items: Add each of your plants with a name
Write down how tall a plant is whenever you measure it, with the date
See how much each plant has grown since you started
See a small growth picture for every plant
Remove a plant or a measurement you no longer want

sections.title: The screens
items: One page with a box at the top to add a new plant
A card for each plant with its latest height and a small growth chart
Inside each card, a box to type a new height and a list of past measurements

sections.title: What happens when you tap
items: Tapping Add plant puts a new card on the page
Tapping Save height adds the measurement with today's date and updates the chart
The growth number is worked out as the newest height minus the first one
Tapping Remove asks the app to forget that plant or measurement

sections.title: What it remembers
items: Every plant and every measurement
Everything is kept in your browser, so it is still there after you close the page

sections.title: How I will check it works
items: Adding a plant really adds it
Growth is worked out correctly, even with only one measurement
Removing a measurement updates the growth number

sections.title: The parts I will build
items: Toolbox: Project card - the app's name and how to run the checks
Screens: Main screen - the page with the plant cards
Screens: Colors and layout - friendly green colors that also fit a phone
Rules: Growth rules - adding plants, saving heights and working out growth
Memory: Memory box - saving and loading your plants
Checks: Automatic checks - trying the growth rules with example plants
